reproducibility_observation: Reproduced the Suzuki coupling in 72% yield (lit. 78%). Used Pd(PPh3)4 as specified. Slight yield drop likely due to moisture sensitivity during workup.
Could not reproduce the reported cyclisation. Reaction gave only starting material after 24 h at reflux in toluene. Tried twice with freshly dried solvent.
Reproduced and extended to electron-poor arenes. New substrates gave 60-75% yield. Protocol is robust and scalable.
